notes:
**A delta rule backtested against nothing and reported "0 trades".** Yesterday's fix put the option's greeks into the LIVE runner. The backtest was doing the same thing and its failure is the worse one: delta null on every bar, no signals, and a report saying zero trades - which reads as a verdict on your rule when it is a verdict on the harness. You would have deleted a working idea on the strength of it.

**A rule that reads the greeks now gets them on every bar**, because that is how it decides to trade at all - not only on the bars it trades. The strike being watched is worked out at each bar the same way the pricing pass works it out at each signal, so the delta the rule saw belongs to the contract it would have bought. A bar the contract did not trade gets nothing, never yesterday's number.
